sites.enforcement_snippet:
if amount <= 0:
    raise InvalidTransferAmountError(f"Transfer amount must be positive, got {amount}")

domain_notes: transfer_funds rejects a non-positive amount, guarded by a single boundary check before the balance check. Both existing tests supply a strictly positive amount (30, then 50); neither supplies zero or a negative amount, so the positive-amount boundary is never exercised.
rationale: Selected transfer_funds because its amount boundary check is the sole enforcement and no test supplies a zero or negative amount.
